text:
Rina (Design): Quick review: new confirmation modal when a user turns off automatic retries on the request settings page. Current header: "Turn off retries?" Feels terse.
Leo (PM): Yup. We need to surface the consequence (failed requests, higher latency) and the scope (route vs workspace).
Casey (Eng): Technically it's a workspace-level flag for SDKs but UI toggles per-route. We should be explicit: "Disable automatic retries for this route" and call out propagation.
Nora (Docs): If it's inconsistent, that's confusing. Lean toward "for this route" in the UI and explain workspace impact in docs. I'll prep a snippet.
Rina (Design): Proposed header: "Disable automatic retries for this route" Body: "Transient failures won't be retried automatically. Disabling retries may increase failed responses or surface transient errors to your app." Too wordy?
Devon (SRE): Good content. Shorten first sentence for compact screens: "Transient failures won't be retried automatically." Also add a small bold line: "Action is reversible from Settings > Requests."
a11y-bot: Modal must set focus to the heading on open, include aria-describedby referencing the paragraph, and avoid vague link text. Prefer "Read about retry behavior and idempotency" instead of "Learn more".
Casey (Eng): Button labels: primary = "Disable retries" (destructive), secondary = "Keep retries". Keep it to two buttons.
Leo (PM): Add a tiny propagation note: "This change takes up to 5 minutes to propagate to SDKs." Helps reduce support noise.
Rina (Design): Microcopy proposal:
Header: "Disable automatic retries for this route"
Body: "Transient failures won't be retried automatically. Disabling retries may increase failed responses or cause higher latency for callers."
Link: "Read about retry behavior and idempotency" (opens docs)
Primary button: "Disable retries" (red/destructive)
Secondary button: "Keep retries"
Note under buttons (small): "This change may take up to 5 minutes to reach SDKs. Admins can reverse this in Settings > Requests."
Nora (Docs): I'll add a docs section and propose slug `/docs/retries-idempotency`. Link label: "Read about retry behavior and idempotency".
Devon (SRE): Telemetry: event `retries_disabled` with actor, route_id, and propagation_time. Add an oncall note: disabling retries can spike transient error rates.
Casey (Eng): Tests: ensure modal is keyboard-focusable and screenreader announces heading+description. a11y-bot: Confirmed once attributes are added.
Rina (Design): I'll update Figma and create a small copy PR for translations. Any objections to shipping this in the next patch?
Leo (PM): No objections. Tracking notes: translations, docs link, telemetry, a11y checklist.
Nora (Docs): I'll post slug and doc link by EOD.
Rina (Design): Closing thread after Figma/PR/doc links. Thanks all!
